description: Pay once to check 1-50 ASINs on a schedule (every 1h-24h, for 1-30 days) and record price drops/rises, below-target prices, stock changes and buy box seller changes. Returns watch_id and a secret key; read events with check_watch (free). Price = ASINs x checks x credits (minimum $0.05); the quote shows the exact amount.

buybox.description: Track buy box (default true; false is cheaper)
